No single scalar reliably establishes harmful collapse. Mean pairwise item-embedding cosine measures average alignment: opposite vectors on one axis can average near zero despite severe dimensional collapse; a shared offset can raise cosine while preserving useful differences. Inspect singular-value spectra and effective rank of both item embeddings and final nonpadding history representations, excluding padding. RankMe uses exp(−Σpᵢ log pᵢ), with pᵢ proportional to singular values; covariance-based variants use squared singular values and differ numerically. Compare centered/uncentered spectra, variance, norms, and frequency strata on fixed samples. Low effective rank supports dimensional collapse, but high rank can reflect noise rather than predictive information. [RankMe](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.02885), [recommendation collapse analysis](https://ise.thss.tsinghua.edu.cn/~mlong/doc/Embedding-Collapse-icml24.pdf).

Sampled training margins are optimization diagnostics, not evidence of generalization: easy negatives, memorization, and increasing embedding norms can enlarge margins without improving validation ranking. Report margin distributions and norm changes alongside the unchanged benchmark validation HR@10. Sampling research also cautions against extrapolating sampled ranking performance to full-catalog performance. [Sampled recommendation metrics](https://ijcai.org/proceedings/2021/651).

For stale-history dependence, a useful proposed test is paired validation evaluation retaining progressively shorter recent suffixes, holding users, targets, candidates, and padding/readout conventions fixed. Consistent HR@10 improvement after removing older events supports harmful dependence; score changes alone establish sensitivity. Compare equally sized recent-history removals, stratify by history length/time gaps, and report paired uncertainty. Truncation can introduce distribution shift or remove useful long-term preferences. Gate entropy and saturation distributions describe routing concentration; distinguish categorical entropy from binary-gate entropy. Neither establishes historical influence: residual paths, feature magnitudes, and downstream transformations matter. Gate interventions provide stronger model-level evidence, without establishing causal explanations of user behavior. [Attention interpretation limitations](https://aclanthology.org/N19-1357/).
